introduction.goalContent: Design and orchestrate scalable and automated data infrastructures that guarantee the uninterrupted flow and integrity of enterprise information, enabling high-performance analytical environments.
introduction.journeyContent: I started my career building data extraction flows in the global manufacturing sector, automating the feed of information from Oracle to SQL Server. Currently, I lead the data architecture in the ERP consulting sector, designing PostgreSQL schemas and developing Python pipelines to centralize business operations, ensuring technical stability and performance of cloud servers.
introduction.locationSubtitle: Base of operations and geographic availability
introduction.aboutContent:
I am a Data Engineer focused on the design, construction, and optimization of scalable data infrastructures. I turn information ecosystems into fluid and centralized pipelines. My focus lies in the creation and organization of ETL processes, relational database architecture, and data extraction automation.

My work guarantees the availability, integrity, and quality of data. By integrating APIs and modeling efficient relational schemas, I facilitate the processing of information flows in real time and without bottlenecks. This not only optimizes database server performance, but also ensures that Business Intelligence and Data Science teams have solid foundations on which to base decision making.

img5.title: Budget Control Data Pipeline
img5.desc: I develop the data ingestion infrastructure for the finance area with the aim of automating budget monitoring. I structure a robust ETL process in C# that extracts massive information from accounts payable invoices and general journal entries from the Oracle system. I normalize scattered catalogs by modeling relational schemas in SQL Server. I transform these raw data into calculated and clean datasets automatically.

img3.title: Labels
img3.desc: Desktop application developed for the Warehouse area to improve supplier traceability for each product. It queries Oracle via API using the order number to retrieve the Supplier Part Number and Daikin Part Number, then sends the data to the printer to generate a label including a barcode for easy scanning. Label generation was implemented using iText NuGet 5.5.13.5. The system includes a JSON configuration file that allows users to adjust the label size without requiring code changes. Reduced process times by over 50%.

img4.title: MasterLabels Data Architecture
img4.desc: I build the database architecture and data pipeline (using ASP.NET and MySQL) to diagnose a critical problem in logistics label printing. I structure the ingestion of large volumes of data through the efficient capture of granular variables (LPN, lines, times). I optimize queries to support massive loads and export this information to the analytical layer. This robust data processing allowed discovering the technical root cause and justifying a latency adjustment in Oracle that collapsed the monthly incidence rate.

img2.title: Overtime Request Processing System
img2.desc: I architect the data structure and processing flow of an internal platform designed to calculate logistics costs. I design the relational model to store and cross-reference multiple variables (personnel records, routes, times) using optimized SQL queries. I implement this logic in C# ensuring that financial calculations are processed quickly and accurately from the server side, ensuring data integrity for corporate internal audit processes.

img1.title: Data Architecture and ERP Ecosystem
img1.desc: I analyze, design, and architect the central relational model in PostgreSQL for the deployment of the corporate ERP ecosystem. I translate complex workflows and business rules into a rigidly normalized database structure. I guarantee the referential integrity of the information and optimize indices to ensure superior performance during massive ingestion, connection, and extraction of cross-referenced data among different company operating departments.

img2.title: Data Pipeline for SAJI Dashboards
img2.desc: I orchestrate the underlying data infrastructure to power the company's Business Intelligence environment. I develop extraction pipelines in PostgreSQL and Python that query raw operational databases, transform the information, and serve it in real time to the visualization layers. This data engineering ensures that corporate management reviews commercial, logistics, and financial KPIs with minimal latency and zero inconsistencies.

img3.title: Data Performance Monitor
img3.desc: I develop and implement automation scripts oriented to continuously audit database integrity and server health. I extract technical performance metrics using Python code to proactively identify bottlenecks in the data infrastructure. I automate maintenance tasks to prevent downtime, ensuring that enterprise information channels operate without interruption.

wids2025.h1: Pipeline architecture for mass data cleansing and preprocessing.

img1.title: WiDS Datathon 2025: ADHD Predictive Pipeline
img1.desc: I design and build a robust and comprehensive data pipeline in Python geared towards preprocessing complex volumes of medical information. I apply cleansing processes, imputation of null values, and strict normalization on neuroimaging databases. Through advanced Feature Engineering techniques, I transform raw data into structured and highly separable tensors, ensuring that the data environment is optimal for the ingestion and training of the Machine Learning model (XGBoost) with clinical accuracy metrics.

wids2025.stack: Python, Pandas, ETL Processes, Data Normalization

img1.title: WiDS Datathon 2022: Oncology Data-Driven
img1.desc: I develop the necessary extraction and transformation processes to analyze massive oncological datasets. I audit and cross-reference heterogeneous medical databases with sociodemographic records, executing advanced normalization techniques in Python to standardize formats. This data engineering effort guaranteed the integrity of training sets, allowing subsequent analytical layers to successfully evaluate the probability of definitive diagnoses in periods of less than 90 days.

wids2022.stack: Python, Normalization, Data Extraction, Relational Databases
